name: nanyx
description: Nanyx language support: syntax highlighting, diagnostics and running files

nanyx.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `nanyx` executable (the compiler, which is also the language server). Leave empty to use the `nanyx` on PATH, or to download a release into the extension's storage.

nanyx.developmentMode.markdownDescription: For working on the compiler: runs the language server from a copy of the `#nanyx.path#` build, so the build is never locked and `dotnet build` can overwrite it, and restarts the server with a fresh copy whenever the build changes. Needs `#nanyx.path#` to be set.

nanyx.compilerVersion.markdownDescription: Pins the compiler release to download and use when no `nanyx` is found, e.g. `0.5.2`. Leave empty to use the newest compiler release (checked for at most once a day).

nanyx.downloadUrl.markdownDescription: Where to download the compiler from. `${version}`, `${rid}` (e.g. `win-x64`) and `${ext}` (`zip` or `tar.gz`) are substituted. Leave empty for the GitHub releases of nanyx-lang/nanyx. With a custom URL the newest release cannot be looked up, so `nanyx.compilerVersion` (or the extension's minimum version) is downloaded.

nanyx.asciiTypes.markdownDescription: Write the types that hovers, lenses, inlay hints and completions show in ASCII only: inferred type variables are `a`, `b`, `c`, ... rather than `α`, `β`, `γ`, …, and the rest of an open record is `...` rather than `…`.

nanyx.greekTypeVariables.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#nanyx.asciiTypes#` instead. Turning this off still turns ASCII types on.
nanyx.greekTypeVariables.markdownDescription: Name inferred type variables `α`, `β`, `γ`, … in hovers.

enumDescriptions: As an inlay hint after each top-level definition's name, like the hints for locals and parameters.
In a lens above each top-level definition.
nanyx.topLevelTypeHints.markdownDescription: Where to show the inferred type of a top-level definition that does not write its type. `off` and `inlayHint` pass `--top-level-type-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.

nanyx.inlayHints.localDefinitions.markdownDescription: Show an inlay hint with the inferred type of each local definition (a `def` in a block) that does not write its type. Turning it off passes `--no-local-type-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.

nanyx.inlayHints.parameters.markdownDescription: Show an inlay hint with the inferred type of each lambda parameter that does not write its type. Turning it off passes `--no-parameter-type-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.

nanyx.inlayHints.patternVariables.markdownDescription: Show an inlay hint with the inferred type of each variable a pattern binds. Turning it off passes `--no-pattern-variable-type-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.
